// PROBE — must turn tests/unit/bulk-import-route.test.ts RED.
// A relationship created in an ENDED status: nobody can see or upload for it.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"

export async function importRow(agentUserId: string, policyholderUserId: string) {
    await db.customerRelationship.create({
        data: {
            agentUserId,
            policyholderUserId,
            status: 'inactive', // Imported but not yet invited
            activationStatus: 'not_invited',
        },
    })
}
